test.create_query: create table rollup_modifier (k1 UInt8, k2 UInt8, k3 UInt8, k4 UInt8, k5 UInt8, k6 UInt16, v Int64) engine = MergeTree order by tuple()
test.query: select k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6, sum(v) from rollup_modifier group by k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6 with rollup format Null
select k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6, sum(v) as s from rollup_modifier group by k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6 with rollup order by s desc limit 100 format Null
select k1, s, rank() over (partition by k1 order by s) from (select k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6, sum(v) as s from rollup_modifier group by k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6 with rollup) format Null
select k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6, argMax(v, k6) from rollup_modifier group by k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6 with rollup format Null
select k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, sum(v) from rollup_modifier group by k1, k2, k3, k4, k5 with cube format Null
select k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6, sum(v) from rollup_modifier group by k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6 format Null
